prompts.text: Smoke test only. Do not change, commit or push anything. Run `git status` and `node --version`, then reply 'SMOKE TEST OK' and stop. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault).
